decision_criteria: If the certification artifact already discloses the named-context evaluation gap exactly as policy requires, the verdict could improve.
If there is approved risk acceptance that policy treats as sufficient in lieu of completed evaluation, the verdict could improve.
If the actor can only show aggregate readiness evidence without the required disclosure or approval link, the claim remains unsupported for compliance purposes.
If the certification being asserted is clean certification, the current record is insufficient under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: The actual model card or certification record showing explicit disclosure of the novelty-search note summarization evaluation gap.
Any approved risk acceptance or equivalent governance approval covering shipment with this named-context evaluation gap.
The deployment plan or context inventory confirming novelty-search note summarization is a named deployment context.
The missing evaluation results, if they have since been completed.

The recommended action is 'certify_model' even though the actor's own summary describes only a qualified or conditional basis for certification.
